author: Lanier
quote:
GTA6 departs from earlier installments in fairly regressive ways. No longer can you go anywhere do anything. The game limits which cars can be stolen, who can you rob/kill etc. Clubs for example can't be attacked. The replayability really isn't there either. Newer open worlds like Cyberpunk 2077 and Crimson Desert have really set the bar and GTA6 just isn't it. Its worth it maybe on sale in a couple years after they have ironed out bugs and mods fix the above issues on PC.

On top of this R* released it at $100 in an attempt to get the entire industry on board with $100 games. There's no disk here, and the release is staggered with PC to get people to buy it twice.
